title: DEF CON 1996 and the Origin of the Capture-the-Flag Format
explainer: The capture-the-flag format this lesson has you practice traces back to DEF CON 4 in 1996, where attendees first competed to breach and defend services on a shared network for points; DEF CON's CTF is still running three decades later and is widely considered the oldest continuously-held contest of its kind. The format evolved from an open free-for-all into the structured attack-defense and jeopardy-style contests, and the qualifier-then-finals structure, that most CTF teams now train around. It's a useful reminder that this training method was improvised by hackers at a conference, not designed top-down by a testing company.
